summary: Implemented prepareUpdate following the prepareQuery pattern in the rdflib repo. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py: new Update class wrapping the translated algebra list (.algebra, iterable). (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py: new prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) returning Update with _original_args set; SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update now accepts an Update object by unwrapping .algebra. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py: exports prepareUpdate. (4) test/test_sparql_prepare_update.py: new tests for return type, repeated execution via Graph.update, initNs handling, and _original_args. Not run, per instructions; nothing committed. Design choices: Update holds only algebra (no prologue, since prologues are per operation); processUpdate still accepts strings only.
